foot: One page, one link, kept current (his order of 2 November). The same list is kept as plain data beside it (items.json) for the advisor's checker.

sections.name: ACTION: One visit to the PC, two steps, about two minutes in all. Step 1, the nightly backup at 05:00 (your pick at 12:58; the app's safety check will not let Claude create a Windows schedule itself): in the Claude app open Scheduled tasks, then "LEDGER: the hourly fresh session", then History, then the run "Today at 2:21 PM". In its message box type: Register the backup schedule now. Click Allow when it asks. It adds one scheduled task named LEDGER backup and nothing else. Step 2, give C: back about 23 GB (Dropbox undoes Claude's script within seconds, tested at 14:27): in File Explorer click Dropbox in the left column, right-click the folder LEDGER backup, choose Make online-only. Nothing is deleted; every file stays in Dropbox and comes back when opened. Then tap Done; the session checks that the task exists, the folder is online-only and the backup is still complete.
sections.recommendation: Do both today: tonight's 05:00 backup then runs whether or not anything is committed, and C: goes from 48.7 to about 72 GB free.
